This procedure describes five different methods for lifting and attaching
 suspension platforms, to enable the work to be done with minimal stress on the
 body.

General
The five lift methods are:
 - Manual balance 
and slide method. See figure 1 &2
 - Handline supported from tower above work location. See figure 3.
 - Handline supported tension from insulator string. See figure 4.

items:
Secure handline block at a suitable position, on tower crossarm, to raise
 platform. See figure 1.

At ground level tie handline around platform above balance point so that
 the conductor hook end will hang as the low point. See figure 1. Tie
 handline onto platform to prevent slippage.

Tilt platform againts crossarm upper cord (feather) and maneuver platform
 onto top of insulator string. Conductor hook should be pointing downward.
 Platform should be straddled between the tower crossarm and insulatro
 string. See figure 2.

Slide platform along insulator string, and down tower crossarm, until
 conductor hook is clear of insulator string and dead end hardware.
Rotate platform and hook over the conductor.

Adjust and attach both chains (or nylon straps) to convenient tower
 member.
Spread chains (or nylon straps) to stabilize platform.
